frame: Existing 3395 eligible annual-view conversation groups; top-level nonempty explicit nonheader views only
prior_exposure: Exclude the entire known page/copy component of all 24 old diagnostic conversation groups. All 39 blogs and six PMC works are development-only and never untouched test works.

candidate_rules.han_test: Unicode Script Han from frozen linguistic table; this is a script filter, not validated Chinese language

hard_components: All conversations with the same source page_id
All source views and versions of a record/conversation remain together through page membership
Any exact nonheader text hash shared across any annual-file views of at least 200 codepoints joins their pages
Equal NFKC-without-whitespace candidate full-text hashes join pages; normalization is used for copy detection only
Any normalized punctuation-unit hash of at least 64 codepoints shared by candidates or exposed records joins pages
Candidate/exposed-record pairs with normalized 5-codepoint shingle containment >=0.8 of the smaller set and >=40 shared distinct shingles join pages; evaluate all pairs, not approximate retrieval
known_exposure_texts: All nonheader serialized views in the original 24-group private sample; no test text displayed to the assistant
ranking: SHA256 UTF-8 seed + '|' + purpose + '|' + source-key; sort ascending with source-key tie break

sample.representative: minimum purpose=record rank among eligible top-level records in the component
sample.allocation: Sort components by purpose=component rank; first 128 train, next 32 development, next 32 sealed test; if fewer than192, preserve underfill and report design infeasible, do not relax rules or fit
sample.group_key: lexicographically minimum source page_id in full known-edge component; no author key used as input

sequence.unit: punctuation-lines/1.0.0 operational text unit within one exact source view, never a historical conversation turn
sequence.gaps_or_parse_failures: keep coverage; do not bridge missing units; no stop labels from truncation or archive boundary

limits: Known-group split is not proof that all undocumented copying or external lineage is resolved
No author, natural-person, human-origin, clinical, or rhetorical ground-truth label
Selection counts and unit boundaries are design variables; held-out linguistic target values remain uncomputed and sealed
Prior structural census of the archive is disclosed; held-out means not previously substantively inspected or used for linguistic diagnostics
